data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #3): dd-3's independent site count MUST replicate detect.sh's test-file path exclusion (paths matching test/, _test., .test.) so the two counts stay aligned. Note: detect.sh's import-line filter is effectively dead code (it cut -d: -f4- but this sg version emits path:line:content = 3 fields), harmless for this fixture because the legacy_call($$$) pattern doesn't match import lines. The fixture's 5 sites must be genuine call expressions (not imports). A follow-up bug is filed for the detect.sh dead import-filter.
